sources.title: Towards Resource-Rich Mizo and Khasi in NLP: Resource Development ...
sources.snippet: This work presents the first comprehensive effort toward developing high quality linguistic datasets for two extremely low resource languages Mizo and Khasi. We introduce human annotated, gold standard datasets for three core NLP tasks: Part-of-Speech (POS) tagging, Named Entity Recognition (NER), and Keyword Identification.
